svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · ADAPTIVE DEPTH, LAYERSKIP & MIXTURE-OF-DEPTHS (#379)
LayerSkip Self-Speculative Decoding vs. Mixture-of-Depths vs. Early-Exit
Self-Speculating at Layer 28 + Parallel 80-Layer Verification Solves the Early-Exit Missing KV Cache Wall (1.86x Speedup)
Tier 1 Trap: Naive Early-Exit Breaks Upper KV Cache
• Token t exits early at Layer 28 when softmax confidence > 0.95
• Layers 29..80 never compute K_t, V_t for Token t!
• When Token t+1 needs all 80 layers, upper attention lacks K_t, V_t
• Accuracy Collapses From 82.6% Down to 64.2% (-18.4 pts!)
• Draft Phase: Uses first 28 layers + shared LM_Head to draft K=5
tokens (0.0 GB extra draft model weights in HBM!)
• Verify Phase: Runs Layers 29..80 in parallel on all 5 tokens, filling
100% exact KV Cache + 82.6% Lossless Accuracy at 1.86x Speedup!
4-Tier Adaptive Depth & Layer Skipping Matrix (70B 80-Layer · Baseline TPOT = 18.0 ms)
Tier 1 (Naive Early-Exit L=28) : Speedup = 1.45x | TPOT = 12.4ms | Accuracy = 64.2% (-18.4) | Extra HBM = 0GB
Tier 2 (KV-Copy Approx Early-Exit) : Speedup = 1.38x | TPOT = 13.0ms | Accuracy = 76.8% ( -5.8) | Extra HBM = 0GB
Tier 3 (Pre-Trained MoD 50% Cap) : Speedup = 1.62x | TPOT = 11.1ms | Accuracy = 81.9% ( -0.7) | Extra HBM = 0GB
Tier 4 (LayerSkip Self-Speculative): Speedup = 1.86x | TPOT = 9.7ms | Accuracy = 82.6% (Lossless)| Extra HBM = 0GB
